requirements.statement: I want a companion app that helps testrunner run tests external to token calls. It can be written in go. It needs to be language agnostic e.g. can run rust tests, python tests, etc. It maintains a text based database or sqlite database per project so that it knows exactly what test cases to run and run through and how to get them. A pass is just a pass. We don't even need to tell the AI TestMaster that it passed. A failure is a failure and we should capture the failure output and give that to a file that TestMaster then can go read about the full test. So it should run through the full test cases until there's a blocking test. But if we had 300 tests that are meant to be ran independent, then it runs through all 300 and then it tells TestMaster only of the failures. It can tell it statistics on passing, but I don't need the TestMaster actually seeing and looking at the test.
